papers.title: Last Secure Code Benchmark: Is the Code You Vibe Secure?
papers.desc: AI coding agents now write much of the code that ships, yet whether that code is secure remains unclear.

papers.title: Video-Arena: A Scalable Agentic Video Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Capability
papers.desc: Understanding and tracking a dynamic world are fundamental to visual intelligence.

papers.title: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops
papers.desc: System One models choose an agent's next action by scoring a supplied set of options in a single pass.

papers.title: Omni-Modal LLMs Know More Than They Say
papers.desc: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) extend LLMs to process heterogeneous modalities (e.g., vision, audio, and IMU signals) alongside language, enabling a broader range of multimodal tasks.

papers.title: WorldCast: Distributed Multiplayer World Models
papers.desc: Multiplayer world models must generate independently controlled views with consistent representations of both players and their shared environment.

papers.title: Beyond the Verdict: Agentic Code Judging with Verifiable Feedback
papers.desc: Test-time scaling for large language models (LLMs) can involve generating multiple candidate solutions for selection or revising an earlier attempt.

papers.title: ACCRUE: Continual Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Robot Foundation Models
papers.desc: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves robot foundation models (RFMs) beyond their demonstrations, but real-world deployment demands more: learning new tasks efficiently while retaining previously acquired behaviors.

papers.title: Can an Agent Learn to Predict Its Own Failure? Outcome-Grounded Confidence Calibration in LLM Agents
papers.desc: Controlling an acting LLM agent means deciding, at each step of a long-horizon task, whether to trust its next action, abstain, or hand off to a human.

papers.title: Let the Mind Conceive, Let the Hand Achieve: Following Multimodal Instructions for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
papers.desc: A robot following a multi-step instruction needs to act on the right objects in the right order, even as the scene changes.

papers.title: Scaling Repeated-Data Pretraining: Batch Size, Regularization, and GPU-Time Tradeoffs
papers.desc: We study pretraining when compute is abundant but unique training data are finite, requiring repeated training on the same data.

papers.title: Learning Transferable World-Action Models from Task-Paired Human Videos
papers.desc: World-action models inherit broad visual and physical priors from video pre-training.

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Intent Fulfilment and Assurance for 6G RAN
papers.desc: Intent-based network management automates 6G service lifecycles, but existing fulfilment and assurance approaches require traffic inspection, per-flow tracking, or vendor-internal telemetry.

papers.title: Image Tokenizers Should Be Trained Between Images
papers.desc: Latent diffusion models generate images as codes of an image tokenizer, whose decoder turns them into the pixel image.

papers.title: Words to World: Benchmarking LLMs in Interactive Physical Environments
papers.desc: Words are increasingly becoming an interface for action: large language models (LLMs) can now invoke tools, operate devices, and make decisions that affect the physical world.

papers.title: Enabling Token-wise Importance Sampling in Off-Policy RLVR with Proximal KL Regularization
papers.desc: Off-policy data in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can arise from asynchronous generation, rollout-training mismatch, and response reuse.
